Q: Forwarding C-style struct matrix to constructors of same-size matrix of objects A:

Note : std::array does not take more memory than a "C" style array of the same size. It is mainly syntactic sugar that allows you to pass arrays as objects and return them (including RVO) while not having to decay to raw pointers. So there should be no harm in using std::array

Q: Is Service accounts possible in Facebook for Developers? A:

They have System user and you can define their roles and access. look at https://developers.facebook.com/docs/business-management-apis/system-users/ for more info

Q: files send through bluetooth or wifi in iOS A:

Using BLE or WiFi seems to be the only real choice, Unfortunately both of them have a limited range of around 50m straight line on obstacles. Or you could make a hardware solutions like using Xbee which have a maximum range of 14 km
